Tools:
TS101 soldering iron - https://bit.ly/3HUzrI9 / https://geni.us/owyDm5G
Grinding tool - https://bit.ly/3Te3fEE / https://geni.us/Oc8v3N
Desoldering pump - https://bit.ly/3TuXAvf / https://geni.us/XFMVy7r
Hydraulic crimping tool - https://bit.ly/3wVdnuz / https://geni.us/WmyQL
Wire stripper - https://bit.ly/4dG6Jt2 / https://geni.us/6ep
Cordless drill - https://bit.ly/4bZg5PN / https://geni.us/A5AZi
Drill bit set - https://bit.ly/3S3i6zC / https://geni.us/ktAK1M
Step drill bits - https://bit.ly/3Pe3fU6  / https://geni.us/xYRx7J
Helping hand - https://bit.ly/3B9mIgt / https://geni.us/Yyqyte

Hi everyone! 

In this video I decided to show you have I made this simple and cheap spot welder which is a highly useful tool for a DIY'er that can be used in many different projects for creating rechargeable battery packs! Nowadays, lithium batteries are widely using in the electronic products, rechargeable batteries, electric vehicles, balance vehicles, aircraft models, ship models, electronic tools and so on. I am using a microwave oven transformer that I have salvaged a while ago. I also compare my DIY spot welder to a $200+ Mini Intelligent DIY Spot Welder OLED Automatic&Manual Switching Lithium Battery Power Battery Pack Welding Machine SQ-SW1.

Hope you give this project a try! ✌️

g12_videos.title: Laser Security System Using LDR and BC547 Transistor #security
g12_videos.description:
In this video, I’ve made a simple laser security alarm using a BC547 transistor, LDR, buzzer, and a 3.7V battery. When the laser beam is blocked, the buzzer instantly turns ON, triggering the alarm. This is a great mini project for beginners to learn about light sensors and transistors.
Perfect for home safety, school projects, or electronics experiments.
⚡ Powered by a single 18650 cell and works without Arduino!

Components Used:

BC547 Transistor

LDR (Light Dependent Resistor)

Buzzer

1k Resistor

Laser Module (3V)

3.7V Battery
